approval.description: draft until it is posted or asked for; awaiting_approval while a request to post it waits; approved once posted; rejected when the latest request was rejected and it is still a draft.

due.description: overdue once its due date has passed while it is posted and unpaid; not_due otherwise.

ledger.description: not_posted, posted, or voided by a reversal.

payment.description: What has been paid of it. Payments arrive with p1-purchases' payments slice; until then a posted bill is unpaid.
